article.title: 月之暗面 Kimi Linear：線性注意力首度全面超越全注意力，KV 最多省 75%
article.summary: Kimi Linear 以 KDA 與 MLA 採 3:1 混合，在長上下文維持精確檢索並降低 KV cache 與解碼成本。

title_contract.claim: 線性注意力首度全面超越全注意力
title_contract.key_result: KV cache 最多降低 75%，1M 解碼最高提升 6 倍
title_contract.mechanism: 三層 KDA 搭配一層 MLA 的 3:1 混合架構

visual_bible.background: Warm aged parchment with faint grid lines, subtle fibers, gentle creases, restrained edge wear, and a clean premium documentary feel.
visual_bible.border: Fine double-line ink border with small restrained ornamental corner flourishes.
palette: dark ink brown for main type and structure
terracotta for KDA and primary mechanism
dusty indigo for MLA and comparison
muted sage for savings and retained value
warm brick red for growing burden
visual_bible.typography: Centered editorial hierarchy with a small serif eyebrow, large high-contrast headline, and concise terracotta subheadline.
visual_bible.scene_style: Dimensional handcrafted paper-cut tableau with tactile card, wood, road, machinery, doors, boxes, or landscape elements; not a flat diagram.
visual_bible.lighting: Soft warm upper-left light with short consistent lower-right shadows.
visual_bible.label_style: Compact parchment labels with dark type, restrained accent outlines, short leader lines, and small target dots.
visual_bible.takeaway_style: A wide parchment ribbon or paper strip centered inside the bottom safe zone.
continuity_rules: Use the approved hero as the style reference for all inline images.
Keep the same parchment tone, grid strength, border and corner ornaments.
Keep the same title hierarchy and color semantics.
Keep the same paper-craft depth and shadow direction.
Keep labels compact and leader lines short.
Keep all text and objects inside the safe border.
Do not copy the hero composition into inline images.

placement.reason: 以標題主張、3:1 架構與最重要效率結果建立整篇文章的精選圖。

shots.core_idea: Kimi Linear 用較輕的 3:1 混合架構，在長上下文保留精確檢索並降低記憶負擔。
shots.headline: 線性注意力首度全面超越全注意力
shots.scene: A two-route paper-craft race on parchment. On the left, a heavy full-attention machine drags a rapidly growing pile of KV-cache cards. On the right, a lighter vehicle carries three terracotta KDA modules and one indigo MLA module toward a finish line. The comparison is immediately readable without becoming a technical diagram.

labels.meaning: 長上下文的記憶負擔更低

shots.bottom_takeaway: 多數層保持高效率，少數層保留精確比對
shots.alt_text: 全注意力機器拖著大量 KV cache，而 Kimi Linear 以三個 KDA 與一個 MLA 模組輕裝抵達終點。
shots.caption: Kimi Linear 以 3:1 混合架構降低長上下文記憶負擔，同時保留少量全注意力層。

placement.section_heading: KDA：用更細的閘控精煉 Gated DeltaNet
placement.after_paragraph_excerpt: KDA 把閘控的粒度切細，讓同一個固定容量工作區能更精準地寫入、保留與遺忘。
placement.reason: 把較抽象的 finer-grained gating 轉成一眼可懂的門與固定記憶盒。

shots.core_idea: KDA 的優勢不是增加記憶，而是用更細的閘控管理同一塊固定記憶。
shots.headline: KDA 用更細的閘控管理固定記憶
shots.subheadline: 不是增加記憶體，而是更精細地決定寫入、保留與遺忘
shots.scene: A paper-craft mechanism scene matching the hero style. A single coarse stone-and-wood gate on the left is transformed into three separate parchment-and-wood gates in the center: write, keep, and forget. Token cards flow through the gates into one fixed-size compartment box on the right. No person is required.

labels.meaning: 選擇值得進入固定狀態的內容
讓有價值資訊持續存在
釋放有限狀態中的空間
閘控變細，但固定狀態容量不增加

shots.bottom_takeaway: 更細的閘控，不代表更多記憶，而是更聰明地使用同一塊記憶
shots.alt_text: 粗閘門被拆成寫入、保留與遺忘三道細閘門，Token 最後進入同一個固定大小的記憶盒。
shots.caption: KDA 透過更細粒度的閘控，提高固定狀態記憶的使用效率。

placement.section_heading: 75%、6 倍與 6.3 倍：長上下文推論的實際意義
placement.after_paragraph_excerpt: 上下文越長，全注意力的 KV cache 與延遲持續膨脹，混合線性注意力的優勢也越明顯。
placement.reason: 用兩條相同里程的路徑呈現固定狀態與持續增長 KV cache 的負擔差異。

shots.core_idea: 上下文越長，Kimi Linear 的較小記憶負擔與全注意力持續增長的 KV cache 差距越大。
shots.headline: 上下文越長，Kimi Linear 優勢越明顯
shots.subheadline: Kimi Linear 保持較小的記憶負擔；全注意力的 KV cache 會隨上下文持續增長
shots.scene: Two parallel parchment roads matching the approved hero style. The upper Kimi Linear route carries one fixed-state box and a short stack of KV cards from 128K to 1M. The lower full-attention route becomes increasingly cracked and buried under growing piles of KV-cache cards at 128K, 512K, and 1M. No person is required.
scene_elements: fixed-state box and short KV stack

labels.text: 固定狀態 + 較短 KV
labels.meaning: Kimi Linear 的記憶負擔維持較小
全注意力的記憶需求隨上下文增加
特定測試條件下的最佳記憶節省
百萬上下文下的最佳吞吐提升

shots.bottom_takeaway: 長上下文下，混合線性注意力能在保留部分精確檢索的同時，大幅降低記憶成本
shots.caveat: 最佳結果來自測試環境，實際表現仍需依模型、硬體與工作負載驗證
shots.alt_text: Kimi Linear 的固定狀態與短 KV 路徑保持輕量，全注意力路徑的 KV cache 在 128K 到 1M 間持續堆高。
shots.caption: 上下文愈長，固定狀態與持續成長 KV cache 的成本差距愈明顯。
